assessments.reasoning: The source defines a release sequence as maximal and contiguous in an atomic object's modification order and expressly links acquire to release when the acquire reads the value from a side effect in the specified sequence.

challenge.method: Checked same-object scope, modification-order contiguity, later same-thread side effects and RMW membership, and the adjacent consume and fence boundaries.
challenge.results: An equal numeric value alone is insufficient. The reading must be from a qualifying side effect, and the sequence admits later same-thread operations or atomic RMW operations under this draft's exact formulation. Other synchronization rules remain separate.

limitations: The source-specific read relation is required. Numeric equality alone, consume operations, fences, and processor implementations have separate rules.
Scope is the exact N3220 C2y working draft. Published ISO text and observed implementation behavior require separate evidence.
